question: Inamgaon village is located in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inamgaon village** is located in the state of** Maharashtra** in India.
 
• It is situated in the** Pune district **of Maharashtra.
 
• Inamgaon is known for its** archaeological site** that dates back to the** Indus Valley Civilization.**
 
• The site was discovered in the **1950s** and has since been studied extensively by** archaeologists.**
 
• The excavation at Inamgaon has revealed important information about the **early agricultural practices** and **social organization **of the Indus Valley Civilization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is a state in central India known for its **cultural heritage and wildlife.**
 
• **Punjab** is a state in northern India known for its** rich history and vibrant culture.**
 
• **Kerala** is a state in **southwestern India** known for its** palm-lined beaches** and serene backwaters.
